FAR AI

https://www.longtermwiki.com/wiki/E138

EU AI Office tender EC-CNECT/2025/OP/0032, Lot 1 led by FAR.AI with SecureBio and SaferAI; FY2024 revenue.

Signals citing this source

  • EU AI Office, S (for): Contracts its own evaluators (FAR.AI-led consortium) rather than relying on lab-chosen ones.
  • FAR.AI, S (for): Selected by the European Commission to lead a three-year CBRN technical-assistance contract, with a regulator as client.
  • FAR.AI, A (for): Pre- and post-deployment red teaming for labs and EU bodies.
  • FAR.AI, P (against): Runs field-building programs that place researchers into labs.
  • FAR.AI, X (for): No commercial products; consulting limited to governments.
  • SaferAI, S (for): Part of the EU AI Office evaluation consortium; sets its own rating methodology.
  • SecureBio, S (for): Evaluates models from many developers; consortium member on the EU AI Office CBRN contract.
